comment: Patroli sarang penyu rutin dan laporan mingguannya rinci. Dana saya terlihat dipakai untuk menyelamatkan tukik.
commentEn: Nest patrols run regularly and the weekly reports are detailed. My donation visibly helps hatchling rescue.

comment: Informasi lapangan mudah dipahami dan tim cepat membalas pertanyaan. Jadwal patroli bisa diumumkan lebih awal.
commentEn: Field updates are easy to follow and the team replies quickly. Patrol schedules could be announced earlier.

comment: Laporan penggunaan dana transparan; saya bisa melihat jumlah sarang yang dijaga. Komunikasi tim sangat konsisten.
commentEn: Fund use is transparent and I can see how many nests are guarded. The team communicates consistently.

comment: Program pemantauan sarang bermanfaat, tapi akses ke lokasi patroli masih sulit. Mohon info rute diperjelas.
commentEn: Nest monitoring is valuable, but reaching the patrol site is hard. Clearer route information would help.

comment: Laporan dampaknya belum rutin dan saya sulit melihat ke mana dana patroli pergi. Mohon bukti kegiatan lebih sering.
commentEn: Impact reports are irregular and I struggle to see where patrol funds go. Please share field proof more often.

comment: Edukasi relawan lokal bagus dan laporan lapangan rutin dibagikan. Fasilitas di pos patroli masih bisa ditingkatkan.
commentEn: Local volunteer training is excellent and field reports arrive weekly. Patrol post facilities could be improved.

comment: Tim penyelam menjaga keselamatan peserta dan laporan transplantasi karang terbuka. Dampaknya terlihat dari pertumbuhan fragmen.
commentEn: The dive team keeps participants safe and coral transplant reports are open. Fragment growth shows real impact.

comment: Hasil transplantasi karang bisa dilihat langsung di lapangan dan didukung foto. Dana donasi jelas dipakai untuk rak dan fragmen.
commentEn: Transplant results are visible in the field with photo proof. Donations clearly fund frames and fragments.

comment: Laporan pemantauan karang informatif, tetapi jumlah peserta per sesi terlalu banyak. Pembagian kelompok bisa diperbaiki.
commentEn: Coral monitoring reports are informative, but each session has too many participants. Smaller groups would help.

comment: Jadwal kegiatan berubah mendadak tanpa pemberitahuan. Data pemantauan karang dibagikan, tapi komunikasinya perlu lebih cepat.
commentEn: The schedule changed abruptly without notice. Coral data is shared, but communication needs to be faster.

comment: Saya menemukan sampah plastik di dermaga yang kurang diawasi. Laporan kebersihan sebaiknya dibagikan agar donor bisa memantau.
commentEn: I found plastic waste at an unmonitored pier area. Cleanup reports should be shared so donors can track progress.

comment: Penjelasan ekosistem mangrove mudah dipahami anak-anak dan warga dilibatkan. Laporan penanaman juga rutin diperbarui.
commentEn: Mangrove explanations are kid-friendly and locals are involved. Planting updates are posted regularly.

comment: Program penanaman mangrove berjalan, tapi area sekitar masih banyak sampah. Mohon laporan kebersihan dan foto lapangan ditambah.
commentEn: Mangrove planting is underway, but the area still has litter. Please add cleanup reports and field photos.

comment: Warga sangat terlibat dan dampak penanaman terlihat jelas. Saya yakin dana donasi sampai ke bibit dan perawatan mangrove.
commentEn: Locals are highly involved and planting impact is clear. I trust donations reach seedlings and mangrove care.

comment: Beberapa papan edukasi rusak sehingga informasi lapangan sulit dibaca. Dana perawatan sebaiknya dijelaskan dalam laporan.
commentEn: Several education boards are damaged, making field info unreadable. Maintenance spending should be explained in reports.

comment: Area yang dipromosikan sebagai hutan mangrove justru penuh sampah. Mohon laporan kebersihan dan bukti penanaman segera.
commentEn: The area promoted as mangrove forest is full of rubbish. Please share cleanup reports and planting proof promptly.

comment: Ekspedisi pemantauan paus aman dan laporan populasi dibuka publik. Dana donasi jelas mendukung riset laut.
commentEn: Whale monitoring expeditions are safe and population reports are public. Donations clearly support marine research.

comment: Staf sigap dan data pemantauan dibagikan tepat waktu, tetapi jadwal keberangkatan sering mundur. Mohon komunikasi lebih awal.
commentEn: Staff are responsive and monitoring data arrives on time, but departures often slip. Please announce changes earlier.

comment: Protokol menjaga jarak aman dari lumba-lumba dijelaskan dengan baik. Laporan survei juga mudah diakses oleh donor.
commentEn: Safe-distance protocols for dolphins are explained well. Survey reports are easy for donors to access.

comment: Informasi pemantauan lumba-lumba jelas, namun cuaca membuat perjalanan kurang nyaman. Mohon laporan lapangan tetap konsisten.
commentEn: Dolphin monitoring info is clear, though weather made the trip uncomfortable. Please keep monthly field reports consistent.

comment: Tim konservasi responsif dan laporan pemantauan dibagikan terbuka. Saya bisa menelusuri dana hingga survei di lapangan.
commentEn: The conservation team responds fast and monitoring reports are open. I can trace funds down to field surveys.

comment: Program penanaman lamun menarik, tapi jadwal perahu terbatas dan laporan dampaknya jarang. Mohon info lapangan lebih sering.
commentEn: Seagrass planting is interesting, but boat schedules are limited and impact reports rare. Please share field updates more often.

comment: Saya ikut menanam lamun dan mendapat penjelasan rinci soal perawatan. Foto lapangan dan laporan dana membuat saya yakin.
commentEn: I joined seagrass planting and got a thorough explanation. Field photos and fund reports make me confident.

comment: Fasilitas dermaga kurang memadai dan tidak ada tempat sampah. Laporan penggunaan dana untuk perbaikan juga belum terlihat.
commentEn: Pier facilities are poor with no bin available. Reports on funds for repairs are also missing.

comment: Program lamun berjalan baik dan warga ramah, tetapi papan edukasi masih kurang. Mohon lebih banyak foto lapangan.
commentEn: The seagrass programme runs well and locals are friendly, but education boards are lacking. Please share more field photos.

comment: Laporan dampak bulanan membuat saya yakin donasi tepat sasaran. Komunikasi tim tentang kegiatan penanaman sangat konsisten.
commentEn: Monthly impact reports make me confident donations are well spent. Team communication about planting is very consistent.
